snippet.title: Deck of Haunts - Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Deck of Haunts Brings Its House of Horrors to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S on October 8, 2026!

The console versions arrive packed with more than a year of major updates since the PC release, including new game modes, creatures, rooms, cards, missions and more!

Since its original PC release in May 2025, Deck of Haunts has undergone a remarkable transformation. More than a year of content updates, new systems and community-driven improvements have dramatically expanded the game, introducing new game modes, dozens of new cards, additional rooms and creatures, a mission and story system, new ways to build and customize decks, major changes to mansion construction and human navigation, and much more. The result is a substantially expanded version of the original PC release.

"BE THE VILLAIN"

In Deck of Haunts, you don't enter the haunted house. You are the haunted house.
By day, construct your mansion, placing rooms and twisting corridors into a deadly labyrinth. Build your deck with cards designed to generate fear, inflict damage and manipulate the humans foolish enough to step inside. When night falls, visitors enter your domain, and the haunting begins.

Use supernatural cards to torment your guests, trigger traps, exploit their fears and drive them toward insanity or death. Drain their essence to fuel your growing power, but choose your victims and abilities carefully: investigators, priests and other dangerous visitors may have the means to fight back.

At the center of your mansion lies your Heart. Protect it at all costs. If the humans reach it and destroy it, your reign of terror comes to an end.

Expand your mansion, discover new cards, unlock increasingly powerful tools and refine your strategy across repeated runs. Every new room changes the paths humans can take, while different decks, creatures, upgrades, missions and game modes open new approaches to creating the perfect house of horrors.

This time, the haunted house gets to win.

#DeckofHaunts
